Courts Reject Multiple Pleas by Politicians and Officials

Several Indian high courts and civil courts have recently dismissed various legal pleas filed by politicians and officials. These rejections include requests for CBI probes, bail, and the quashing of cases related to alleged hate speech, corruption, and personal conduct. The rulings underscore judicial scrutiny of individuals in public life facing legal challenges.
